summary_1line: Episodes from the Siva Puranam recount devotees, demons, and the origins and significance of several sacred Shiva shrines such as Mahakala, Omkara, Kedara, Bhimashankara, and Kasi.

image_candidates.scene_text: A radiant Bilva leaf bursts from the Siva Linga and annihilates the demon Dushana and his army as the scholar Vedapriya prays.
Lord Siva appears and gently places his hand on the fainted shepherd boy Srikara, who had been praying to a small stone idol.
Bhima hurls his sword at the Siva Linga, but Shiva’s divine weapon emerges from the image and shatters the blade into powder.
